title: Earshot — your lecture, in your ears

cues.label: The problem
cues.screen: Earshot title from the pitch deck, then the app opens its request field.
cues.say: For a blind student, ‘as you can see’ can hide the explanation.

cues.label: One request
cues.screen: The microeconomics request is already filled in; click the arrow at 9 seconds.
cues.say: Earshot starts with one request: teach me my latest lecture.

cues.label: Find the lecture
cues.screen: The five-step preparation trace advances through Moodle materials.
cues.say: It combines your Moodle transcript and lecture notes, then explains the visual references in words.

cues.label: Follow the work
cues.screen: Open the detailed activity, show the recorded operations, then return to the milestones. The lesson becomes ready.
cues.say: You can follow its progress, and open the activity log to see the individual steps.

cues.label: Give the diagram a voice
cues.screen: A diagram from the lecture notes, followed by its spoken explanation in the app.
cues.say: Here, a diagram becomes a spoken explanation.

cues.label: Listen to Earshot
cues.screen: Play a real excerpt: ‘The horizontal axis is wealth in pounds, and the vertical axis is utility.’ Words reveal in sync.
cues.say: [SILENCE — let the app speak. Do not read this instruction aloud.]

cues.label: Stay in sync
cues.screen: Switch to 2×, jump to another point, and pause. The transcript follows the audio playhead.
cues.say: The text keeps up when I change speed, pause, or jump ahead.

cues.label: Read and check
cues.screen: Open the full transcript, close it, and expand the original course sources.
cues.say: The full explanation is there to read, with the original course sources just below.

cues.label: Take it with you
cues.screen: Save the actual WAV, then return to the player and synchronized text.
cues.say: Save the audio, and take the explanation with you when the screen stays closed.

cues.label: Close
cues.screen: Earshot brand and its audio-first mission.
cues.say: Earshot. Your lecture, in your ears.
